Restorative · Patient guide

Tooth extraction in Gujranwala

An extraction removes a tooth when removal is the most suitable option after assessment.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

A dentist may recommend removal for a tooth that cannot be restored, or in selected cases of impaction or as part of a wider treatment plan.

What age group is it for?

Children, teens and adults may need an extraction for different reasons. Baby teeth and wisdom teeth require different considerations.

What happens at the appointment?

The dentist checks the tooth, discusses options and numbs the area before removing it. You receive instructions for looking after the site and when to contact the clinic.

Does it hurt?

You may feel pressure during the procedure. Tell the dentist if you feel sharp pain. Soreness afterward varies with the type of extraction.

How much does it cost?

Simple and surgical extractions can be priced differently. Ask whether X-rays, follow-up and any replacement option are included in the estimate.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
